definitions.explanation: A reservation or booking made ahead of general availability, typically offered to members, fans, or priority customers before tickets or products go on sale to the public.

examples.japanese: {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got tickets through a members-only advance booking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けて→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We are accepting advance orders for the new game, so please apply early.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in entertainment (concert tickets, events) and retail (new product launches, limited editions). Often offered as a perk for fan club members or loyalty program participants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pre-order / book in advance)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧ (advance booking reception)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧ (advance booking bonus)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧ (start of advance bookings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: reservation — the general term for any booking
- ⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: advance sale — emphasizes the selling rather than the reserving
